Seller had some excellent suggestions for revising my shop and listings, so I purchased her service for revision of 20-listings, which indicates in her product description that buyers will be "optimized for Etsy SEO (so you turn up on the front page)." Despite multiple attempts to revise the listings, seller was unable to achieve first-page ranking for each of the 20 listings. When I mentioned to her how frustrated and disappointed I felt after spending such a large amount of money on something, which did not deliver, she became defensive and accused me of trying to take financial advantage of her. Moreover, she repeatedly threatened to report my shop to Etsy, alleging buyer misconduct. I have lost all respect for this seller or her work and do not recommend purchasing from her.

Seller did not deliver what is promised in her product description. Specifically, she states in her description that listings will "be optimized for SEO (so you turn up on the front page)." She insists that 9 of my 20 listings did turn up on the front page but that she does not guarantee this (this is mentioned neither in her product description or shop policies). She has become highly defensive when I confronted her about this and then accused me of harassment. I have opened a claim with Etsy dispute resolution, which they would not mediate, and have now had to resort to PayPal dispute resolution in an attempt to get my money refunded. Do not waste your hard-earned money on this seller, who does not deliver and has no concept of customer service.

All in all, it was 55 pages of wasted money, old ideas that were not unique to this person / shop, and I am highly disappointed with it.
